headline: Perez no-hits Phillies in game called after five
recap: Pascual Perez held the Phillies without a hit over five innings as Montreal won 1-0 in a game that was called with Philadelphia's Alex Madrid one out into the sixth. Perez struck out eight and walked one, and the Phillies never got another turn at bat once the game was stopped.

Madrid matched Perez for four scoreless innings before Montreal broke through in the top of the fourth: Otis Nixon led off with a double, Dave Martinez singled him to third, and Andres Galarraga's fielder's-choice grounder brought Nixon home. Hubie Brooks followed with a double, Graig Nettles was intentionally walked to load the bases, and Tom Foley grounded into an inning-ending double play.

The Phillies' only baserunner of the game came in the fifth, when Chris James reached on a throwing error by Nettles before being caught stealing second. Madrid took the loss despite allowing just the one earned run on four hits before the game ended.
